events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: Fort Griffin's offering good money for a lock I shouldn't open. Find me honest work worth the same and I'll take that instead, no promises beyond it.

events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: Paid in full, and nobody had to break in anywhere to earn it. I'd forgotten that felt this good.

events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: A place, not a job I have to keep proving I'm not casing. Fine. I'll ride with the outfit.

events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: I've picked locks that gave up less than you did. That's not a complaint, for once.
